title: Genus-3 Frobenius completion
objective: Implement ordinary exact Hasse-Witt computation, genus-3 Weil-constrained coefficient candidate lifting, and certified completion filters using Jacobian/order oracles, with exhaustive tests and a clear indeterminate status

handoff.summary: Implemented the ordinary Harvey--Sutherland Hasse--Witt matrix convention for smooth odd-characteristic y^2=f models, exact det(I-TW) residues, exhaustive genus-3 p-Weil lifting with a rational Sturm certificate, and streamed exact Jacobian/twist-order, element-order, and live group-annihilation filters. Callback exceptions and non-boolean results propagate, while diagnostics count exact group actions. All result paths distinguish unique, indeterminate, inconsistent, and resource-limit states; direct polynomial expansion is guarded before allocation. Tests cover the published p=97 matrix, five Sage Frobenius fixtures, exact Weil interval/repeated-root boundaries, a 50-candidate ambiguous residue class, certified order and witness completion, invalid models, callbacks, and both resource caps.
risks: The direct Hasse--Witt fallback intentionally caps dense polynomial expansion; large primes require the rforest accelerator.
Unfiltered genus-3 integral lifting is O(sqrt(p)) and deliberately returns resource_limit beyond its configured combination cap.
architecture:check reaches package ownership and fails on this pre-integration branch because the shared hyperelliptic package registration is owned by integration commit 9223559f.
next_steps: Integrate the lazy hyperelliptic package registration and public curve adapters.
Feed batched rforest coefficient residues into complete_genus3_lpolynomial.
Provide certified Jacobian element-order witnesses from the group-law lane for production completion.
